data.title: Jim Cramer Analyzes Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) After Surgical Robotics Milestone
data.description: Jim Cramer celebrated a dramatic pivot in market sentiment surrounding Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) during Mad Money’s July 23 episode.
